_comment: Static catalog of grantable KFC/tool certifications. Loaded via HA's !include directive at config-parse time -- NOT rewritable by any exposed service/script call, same non-agent-writable property as ZenZork's swag_defs.json/loot_table.json (proved out that pattern first). cert_grant/cert_revoke in zen_dojotools_persona_editor validate cert_component against this list; anything not here is rejected outright, closed by default. Add a new cert here (edit this file + ha_reload_scripts) before any tool can gate on it -- an agent has no path to add an entry itself.

infra_container_control.description: Portainer container start/restart/stop/remove via zen_dojotools_infra's container-control codex.
gates: zen_dojotools_infra mode=container_stop/container_remove (d-class, cert + live household-admin ack)

lock_control.description: Physical lock/unlock actuation via zen_dojotools_locks mode=set.
